title: AusbildungsNavigator
description: A pilot training-record workspace connecting paramedic apprentices, report review, and administrative routing diagnostics.
body:
AusbildungsNavigator is a pilot workspace for digital training records in paramedic education. It connects report submission with responsible-reviewer approval and gives administrators a way to understand blocked review workflows.

## What it does

Apprentices submit records, reviewers work through their assigned reports, and administrators can inspect the causes of routing problems rather than treating every missing approval as the same error.

## Recent work

September work grouped routing blockers into clearer causes, improved dashboard guidance, extended diagnostics for training-plan reassignment, and expanded regression coverage for routing, isolation, and onboarding. Demo-reset support helps keep pilot scenarios repeatable.

## Current boundary

Binding use remains subject to professional, legal, and privacy acceptance. This is not an accredited certification system, and AI processing is not assumed to be approved.
